mechanism: Cobicistat is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase ceftazidime levels; ceftazidime is primarily renally eliminated and cobicistat may affect renal function, particularly in patients with underlying renal disease.
action: Monitor renal function and ceftazidime levels in patients with pre-existing renal impairment; consider dose adjustment of ceftazidime if needed based on creatinine clearance.
